store.name: Dr. Designer Clinic Yeongdeungpo
store.tagline: Dermatology clinic in Yeongdeungpo, Seoul — botox, fillers, lifting, skin boosters
store.address: 2F Fairfield by Marriott, 870 Gyeongin-ro, Yeongdeungpo-gu, Seoul (Yeongdeungpo Station Exit 5, 200 m)

settings.hours: Mon–Fri 10:00–20:30 · Sat 10:00–16:30 · Lunch break 13:00–14:00 · Closed on Sundays
settings.holidays: Open on public holidays. Closed on the day of Seollal and Chuseok.
settings.accessibility: On the 2nd floor of Fairfield by Marriott. From the hotel's underground parking, take the elevator. On foot, enter through the door between Starbucks and the hotel and take the escalator.
settings.languages: Korean. Consultations available in English, Chinese and Japanese.
settings.medical: Counter does not give medical advice. Suitability for any procedure is decided by the doctor at the in-person consultation.
